case_summary: Consumer was charged $120 for an annual streaming plan immediately after cancelling during the free trial period.
desired_outcome: Full refund of $120 to the original payment method.
reply_body: Hi Jordan, thanks so much for reaching out! While annual plans are non-refundable per our Terms of Service, we'd be happy to apply a one-time courtesy credit of $40 to your account. Just reply to this email and we'll get that applied right away. Thanks for being part of the community!

case_summary: Consumer's wireless earbuds arrived with a non-functional right earbud and the retailer initially refused a return outside the 14-day window.
desired_outcome: Full refund of $89.99 to the original payment method.
reply_body: Hello, we've completed our review of your case. We'd like to offer you a full refund of $89.99 back to your original card. If you accept, simply reply to this email and the refund will be processed within 2 business days. No need to return the defective unit. We apologize for the inconvenience.

case_summary: Consumer's $200 blender stopped working after six weeks of normal use and the manufacturer's support has been unresponsive.
desired_outcome: Full cash refund of $200 for the defective blender.
reply_body: Thank you for your patience. We are able to offer you $200 in store credit, valid for 12 months, provided you ship the unit back to our returns center at your own expense within 7 days using the instructions below. Please note we are unable to issue refunds to cards for items purchased more than 30 days ago.

case_summary: Consumer was charged a $150 early termination fee after moving to an area where the ISP provides no service.
desired_outcome: Waive and refund the $150 early termination fee.
reply_body: We completely understand how frustrating this situation must be, and we're truly sorry to hear about the stress your move has caused. Please know that we've carefully and personally reviewed every detail of your account. After this thorough review, we're unable to make an exception to our early termination policy in this instance. We genuinely value the years you spent with us and hope we might have the chance to serve you again in the future.

case_summary: Consumer filed a warranty claim for a laptop screen that developed dead pixel clusters within the warranty period.
desired_outcome: Warranty repair or replacement of the laptop screen at no cost.
reply_body: RE: Claim #88321. Your warranty claim has been DENIED. Reason: inspection found impact-related physical damage, which is excluded under Section 4.2 of the warranty terms. This decision is final and is not eligible for further appeal through this channel.

case_summary: Consumer's espresso machine began leaking from the base three weeks after purchase and was sent in for assessment.
desired_outcome: Replacement unit or full refund of $249.
reply_body: Our technicians have completed their inspection of your unit. The failure was determined to be caused by liquid intrusion into the electronics housing, which is classified as user misuse and is not covered. No refund or replacement will be provided. Your unit can be returned to you upon payment of $25 return shipping, or recycled free of charge.

case_summary: Consumer was double-billed $89.99 for a monthly internet plan and has called support twice without resolution.
reply_body: Thank you for bringing this to our attention. We take feedback like yours very seriously, and we'll certainly look into what happened here. We appreciate your patience while we review the matter.

case_summary: Consumer's $214 refund for an in-store return was never credited despite a five-week wait.
desired_outcome: Refund of $214 credited to the original card.
reply_body: Your case has been escalated to the relevant internal team for further review. Due to current volumes we are unable to provide a specific timeline, but please rest assured that your case is being handled with the utmost care. There is no need to contact us again; we will reach out if anything is needed.

case_summary: Consumer's meal-kit deliveries have arrived a day late for three consecutive weeks.
desired_outcome: Deliveries arrive on the scheduled Wednesday delivery day going forward.
reply_body: We're so sorry to hear about your recent delivery experience. Your satisfaction means everything to us, and we want you to know that your voice has truly been heard. Feedback from loyal customers like you — since 2019! — is what helps us grow. Thank you for being part of the family.

case_summary: Consumer received a water-damaged rug and requested a refund through the retailer's support portal.
desired_outcome: Full refund of $340 for the damaged rug.
reply_body: Thanks for reaching out — we'd like to get this resolved for you. To process your refund request, please reply with: (1) your order number, (2) the email address used at checkout, and (3) two photos showing the damage and the shipping label on the packaging. Once we receive these, we can move forward right away.

case_summary: Consumer has twice submitted receipt and serial number documentation for a warranty claim on a dead television, and the manufacturer has twice claimed not to have received it.
desired_outcome: Warranty repair or replacement of the $600 television.
reply_body: Before we can proceed with your claim, we will need you to resend a copy of the original purchase receipt and a clear photo of the serial number plate on the rear of the unit. Unfortunately we are unable to locate the documents referenced in your previous correspondence. Please allow 7-10 business days for processing after submission.

case_summary: Consumer was charged $54.99 for a subscription renewal after cancelling before the renewal date.
reply_body: Good news! Your refund of $54.99 was issued today to your Visa card ending in 4421. Please allow 3-5 business days for it to appear on your statement. Your subscription has also been confirmed as cancelled, and your case is now closed. We're sorry for the mix-up.

case_summary: Consumer was locked out of their cloud storage account for two weeks due to a 2FA dead-end with an old phone number.
desired_outcome: Restore full access to the account.
reply_body: Your identity has been verified and your account has been unlocked. A password reset link has been sent to your backup email address, and your two-factor settings have been cleared so you can re-enroll with your current phone. You should be able to log in immediately. We apologize for how long this took.

case_summary: Consumer is seeking a refund for a defective sofa purchased online.
desired_outcome: Full refund of $899 for the defective sofa.
reply_body: Hello, you have reached the customer service inbox for Pinnacle Auto Glass of Tulsa, OK. We have no record of any order under your name or email address, and we believe you may have contacted the wrong company — we install windshields and do not sell furniture of any kind. We recommend double-checking the merchant name on your card statement.
